* '''Original''' ([[Red 12]]): PC card image of 27 September 2019<ref name="ht-r12-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0f2c3fe/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/red12.gif red12.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0f2c3fe 0f2c3fe] (27 September 2019).</ref>, no errata mark.  Text: “May add 1 pilot. If Puck Naeco piloting, he may be placed in Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when he is forfeited. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Red 12 (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)<ref name="sheetP-20221212">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF, 2 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, Updated December 2022”; file created 12 December 2022). Released with [[Virtual Set P]] (24 February 2017 and 30 August 2019); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 12 December 2022: “May add 1 pilot. If Puck Naeco piloting, he may be placed in Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when he is forfeited. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.” '''What changed:''' Changed words: the slip is the first publication of the wording of the card image [[Red 12 (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), which the PC published after the sheet. The game text words are unchanged. The sheet PDF was created at 08:37 UTC on 12 December 2022, before the card image [[Red 12 (Errata 2)]] was uploaded (22:10 UTC, 3 January 2023). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Red 12 (Errata 2)]] (published 3 January 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Red 12”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Red 1]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 3 January 2023<ref name="ht-r12-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/red12.gif red12.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: re-rendered by the PC in its current card style (new frame and text font); a small “71” is added beside the Premium icon. Same words. Text: “May add 1 pilot. If Puck Naeco piloting, he may be placed in Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when he is forfeited. Immune to attrition < 4.”
